questions.stem: In the replicate volumetric flask exercise below, a student notes the observed value. Why is fluorescence often more sensitive than absorbance spectroscopy?

options.text: Because fluorescence does not require any excitation light source

options.text: Because atoms absorb light only at visible wavelengths
